text: The patient was not offered surgical intervention given her multiple medical comorbidities coupled with the risks of the complex multi-stage procedure that would be needed to address her extensive OPLL. Further, it was determined that given the progression of her disease at presentation, surgical intervention would offer only minimal functional improvement if successful. The patient was offered a regimen of duloxetine, gabapentin, tramadol, and acetaminophen for chronic back pain management and opted for conservative management.
